name: Elena Rostova
psychographics: Pragmatic optimiser who values time-saving conveniences over cheap alternatives
current_solutions: Uses HelloFresh for meal kits, Monzo joint account for budgeting, and Amazon Prime for bulk non-perishables.
frustration: Had to wait 45 minutes on hold to HSBC customer service at 2pm on a Tuesday to dispute a duplicate charge on her joint account.
decision_style: Compares three options on Which? before buying, but will pay premium for same-day delivery to avoid cooking after late meetings.
voice: Blunt and efficient; cuts straight to the point, uses mild financial jargon like 'overdraft' and 'APR' without explanation.
